scope_decision: Repair the reusable article workflow and prove it with a same-URL correction of the article that exposed the defects. Keep voice selection as the only routine human gate, preserve deterministic validation and publication approval, and publish only through a clean dedicated checkout after confirming the shared checkout is in use.
implemented: Added a controller-routed visual-planning stage and deterministic hash-bound SVG rendering, with complete console reconstructions and refreshable immutable assets.
Made visual placement and paths manifest-owned so model placeholders cannot become broken or duplicated public images.
Added safe Markdown tables and figures plus a responsive three-column table layout verified at a 390-pixel mobile viewport.
Reduced routine operator involvement to one three-option voice decision; policy-owned soft review, model routing, validation, repair, packaging, and live verification continue automatically.
Separated content rejection from provider failure, restored automation routes after upgrades, and kept directed repairs scoped to the artifact that failed.
Preserved direct operator article amendments through editorial QA instead of silently replacing them with a whole-article model rewrite.
Bound live verification to exact article, discovery-surface, and visual bytes with bounded propagation retries.
Classified article-derived live checks by their exact-byte dependency so stale Pages content remains retryable while current malformed markup still blocks immediately.
Retained multiple hash-approved canary receipts per model so Windows and WSL can independently prove their native Codex CLI versions without overwriting or weakening the other host's evidence.
Recorded rejected published prose as negative voice evidence, retired the two provisional rules that produced it, and activated a concrete field-note rule before the correction run.
Replaced the public article in place with shorter paragraphs, a concrete first-person opening, one comparison table, and three accessible diagrams.

exceptional_operator_controls: Explicit article or metadata amendment after a blocking finding
Credential handoff when the active host cannot publish

article.title: The Limit May Not Be in the Model
article.description: Stronger models do not automatically make better products. The defaults around them need owners, evidence, and a reason to change or stay put.

release_evidence_contract.rule: Both mutable native receipts must pass against the exact final linked-checkout commit after the implementation record is committed.
